title: Buyer Portal Terms: Reinstatement of Removed Option Lines on Design Studio Selections Files
content:
A buyer may put back the most recently removed option line on the Design Studio Selections file through the buyer portal; the reinstated line keeps the catalog code and category of the removed line, is written under the change order that removed it and is recorded against the most recent selection appointment on the file. A reinstated line is priced at its reinstatement price alone, never at a quoted price or at the current studio price, whether or not the appointment it is recorded against falls within the package's price protection days. The reinstated line's price is added to the file's option total.

**Conditions**

A removed option line is reinstated only after every option deposit payment returned unpaid on the file carries its returned payment fee line. The reinstatement price is not fixed until the package allowance applied to the removed line stands returned on the file under its own credit memo.

## Buyer portal tool: `reinstate_option_line_5b4fa2c4`

**Capability.** One call adds one option line to the buyer's selection sheet, dated today, with the catalog code and category of the removed line it reinstates, the change order it belongs to, the selection appointment it is recorded against and a new printed line number, at the price entered, and adds that price to the file's option total. The buyer sees the new line number and price on the selection sheet straight away.

**Invocation.** This tool belongs to the buyer: the representative unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `selection_id` | The reference number of the buyer's Design Studio Selections file, as given by the representative | Id |
| `source_line_ref` | The line number of the removed option line being put back, exactly as printed on the selection sheet and read to the buyer by the representative | Verbatim, copied character for character |
| `change_order_number` | The change order number the line is written under, exactly as read to the buyer by the representative from the design ledger | Verbatim, copied character for character |
| `appointment_seq` | The sequence number of the most recent selection appointment on the file, the appointment the reinstated line is recorded against, as read to the buyer by the representative | Whole number, 1 or more |
| `price` | The price of the reinstated line | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `design_event_id` (the reference number of the new line entry), `option_line_ref` (the line number printed for the reinstated line, OPT-DSI- followed by five digits), `source_line_ref` (as passed), `option_code` (the catalog code carried over from the removed line), `price` (the price booked, USD with 2 decimals), `option_total` (the file's option total in USD including this line) and `status`, which reads "reinstated" when the line was written.
